text: Advertisement Dwarkesh Patel is one of the most important voices in the artificial intelligence world. Deeply embedded in San Francisco’s tech community, he has interviewed nearly every tech chief executive at length. This week’s guest host, Tyler Cowen, a professor of economics at George Mason University, sits down with Mr. Patel to discuss why researchers are resigning, whether A.I. could become conscious and if he’ll ever get an A.I. girlfriend. Below is an edited transcript of an episode of “Interesting Times.” We recommend listening to it in its original form for the full effect. You can do so using the player above or on the NYTimes app , Apple , Spotify , Amazon Music , YouTube , iHeartRadio or wherever you get your podcasts. Tyler Cowen: Dwarkesh Patel, welcome to “Interesting Times.” Dwarkesh Patel: Thanks for having me. Cowen: I’ve known you for a long time, but let me introduce you to everyone else. You were born in India, moved all over America and graduated from University of Texas, Austin, in computer science.
